# Blockulator

> FP127: signed 127.128 fixed-point math for the EVM, about 38 decimal
> digits in one int256 against 18 for the usual WAD libraries, deployed as
> one callable contract on Ethereum Sepolia and available as an inlinable
> Solidity library. Every op is a read-only eth_call: no gas, no wallet, no
> transaction. Agents get results more precise than a double by calling it.

## What it is

- 37 operations: add, sub, mul, div, fromFixed18, toFixed18, exp, exp2,
  exp10, ln, log2, log10, log2Up, sqrt, cbrt, pow, gavg, hypot, inv, abs,
  neg, sign, min, max, clamp, avg, zeroFloorSub, dist, lerp, floor, ceil,
  frac, round, gcd, factorial, lambertW0, lambertWm1.
- Encoding: every operand and result is an int256 holding value * 2**128.
  Decode by dividing by 2**128. Range about +/- 1.7e38.
- Checked arithmetic: out-of-domain inputs revert with Overflow(),
  DivisionByZero() or OutOfRange(). Nothing wraps.
- Validated against mpmath at 200 decimal places: integer and rounding
  ops bit-exact, transcendentals 115 to 130 correct bits.
  /data/precision.json
- Machine-readable op table (signature, selector, domain, reverts):
  /data/ops.json

## How to call it

- Network: Ethereum Sepolia, chainId 11155111
- RPC: https://ethereum-sepolia-rpc.publicnode.com
- FP127: 0xA7Fb462A3733f24785a9AE8d7FbD4F87D8BC4c28 (CREATE2 through
  0x4e59b44847b379578588920cA78FbF26c0B4956C, salt "FP127 v1"; record at
  /contracts/deployments/FP127.md and /data/fp127.json)
- ABI: /data/abi.json. All functions are pure; selectors are in /data/ops.json.
- Example: sqrt(2) is `sqrt(int256)` with 2 * 2**128 =
  680564733841876926926749214863536422912; the result divided by 2**128 is
  1.41421356...
- Inline form: contracts/src/fp127/FP127Lib.sol in the repository,
  `forge install securedataresearch/blockulator`, remapping
  fp127/=lib/blockulator/contracts/src/fp127/.
- Manifest with the same data: /.well-known/agent.json

## The precision claim, as data

- /data/ladder.json: nine iterated scenarios (daily compounding, an
  amortising loan, exp(ln(x)) round trips, ...) through FP127, FP127Lib,
  ABDKMath64x64, Solady and PRBMath for N in 1..10000, each cell with the
  decoded value, correct significant digits, relative error and gas per
  step, against exact arithmetic. Daily compounding at N = 365: FP127 36
  digits, Solady and PRBMath 16, ABDK 17.
- Any cell can be re-run on chain: LadderRunner at
  0x3FD3461EE53F9C6f2322CbB3fF97A3EdA522d4a4,
  run(uint8 scenario, uint8 form, uint32 n) returns (bool ok, int256 raw,
  bytes4 reason, uint256 gasPerStep). Scenario ids and forms are in
  /data/scenarios.json and /contracts/deployments/Ladder.md.
- /data/gas.json: gas per op and form, min/median/max.

## Pages

## Notes for agents

- Reads are free and need no key; do not send transactions for math.
- Sepolia only today; there is no mainnet address yet.
- The Vyper calculators listed in /.well-known/agent.json with
  "status": "archived", and the games and futures market on /archive/,
  still run but call the legacy Huff FP127 and are not maintained. Use the
  FP127 contract above.
